headline: Adani Enterprises Limited: Qualified Institutional Placement – Allotment of Equity Shares
sum: Adani Enterprises Limited completed allotment of equity shares under a QIP to eligible qualified institutional buyers on 7 July 2026. The allotment was processed by NSE and BSE following subscription closure.
detail: Adani Enterprises, a listed entity in the Adani Group infrastructure portfolio, issued equity shares to qualified institutional buyers under the exempted QIP route (no retail component). The allotment notice was filed with NSE (primary exchange) and BSE on 7 July 2026, following subscription finalization. QIP is a rapid capital-raising tool under SEBI ICDR Rules 2018 Regulation 95, which permits listed large-cap companies to raise capital from institutional investors without a public offering or cooling-off period, subject to board and shareholder approval.
